name: agentscope
description: Windows-native control and trace layer for local AI coding agents.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @agentscope/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/core run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @agentscope/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/core run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/desktop run typecheck
scripts.i18n:check: npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run check
